reason: A DeepSeek Harness web search provider that queries Exa through an anonymous MCP fallback or keyed REST API and exposes normalized results to existing web search tools.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Exa 的网页搜索，通过匿名 MCP 或配置的 REST API 获取并规范化搜索结果。
summaries.en: Provides Exa-powered web search for DeepSeek Harness through an anonymous MCP fallback or a configured REST API, with normalized results for existing web search tools.

capabilities: Performs web searches through Exa REST or MCP endpoints
Makes outbound network requests to configurable external endpoints
Reads an Exa API key from configuration or an environment variable
Registers a web search provider for DeepSeek Harness
